scope: Chapter 1 reconstructs the classical curve of fiber components for every surjective holomorphic map from a connected compact complex manifold to a compact curve. Chapter 16 now applies its full model-space description to all such maps, including critical and disconnected fibers, without assuming a separate factorization. Nonnegative base area is exactly the nonemptiness condition; zero area gives the smooth singleton. The two fiber normalizations and the obstruction to pushing polar traces to the original base remain explicit.
